dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Vanilla arrived at MACC as a stray with no known history. While in care, he has been observed to be highly fearful. Noted to have a tense body, pinned back ears, and began seeking exit. During intake, Vanilla was noted to hard stare and growl at handlers. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult-only home.
dog.name: Vanilla Froyo
